integrity: Proof is fully analytic. The small tetrahedral word and side-length checks are consistency tests, not a substitute for the proof. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Requires scalene Euclidean triangular facets of a full-dimensional convex three-polytope with identical outward cyclic edge-length order; mixed chiralities and nonconvex surfaces are not classified.
title: Monochiral scalene triangular facets force a disphenoid
